methods.name: Tetrahedral endpoint-sum residual / affine torsion analyzer
capabilities: exact Z^2 x C2 residual classification on zero-total edge states
canonical representative and explicit zero-total lift certificate
F2 affine support and opposite-edge complement readout
methods.core_law: For the zero-total K4 endpoint-sum system, quotient equality is exactly equality of the two free opposite-edge coordinates plus one star-parity bit; the primitive parity class doubles into the integer image.
methods.hard_boundary: K4/four-slice six-line carrier specialization only. This executable does not identify carrier lines with native P000 axes, infer a physical metric, or replace general T6/T7/T9 machinery.

methods.name: Shared-square paired positive/negative Pell shell certificate
capabilities: verify a shared-P positive and negative Pell pair
certify P^4-1=(P^2-1)(P^2+1) and the fused discriminant product
verify the P=99 N=58 integer constants
return exact geometric-tail bounds from a supplied ratio certificate
methods.core_law: If P^2-d_plus*y_plus^2=1 and P^2-d_minus*y_minus^2=-1, then P^4-1=d_plus*d_minus*(y_plus*y_minus)^2.
methods.hard_boundary: Integer/rational certificate layer only. It does not derive a modular parametrization, a Ramanujan-CM identity, or a native geometric meaning for the Pell shells.
